Baidu Netdisk sign-in
Read before use
Baidu Netdisk has strict risk control, which may restrict your account.
The following issues are usually caused by risk control, not a software fault:\n· Failed to obtain bdstoken\n· Personal netdisk file list will not load
Avoid high-frequency operations (frequent parsing/transfers/downloads/uploads). If issues occur, reduce usage or try again later.
I have read and understood the risks above
1. Sign in to your Baidu account in the web page below
2. Sign-in is detected automatically. If not, tap \"Save\" in the top-right corner
3. Or tap the \"Paste\" icon to enter the Cookie manually (must include BDUSS=)
4. The Cookie is long-lived; sign in again once it expires

Why is there no web sign-in?
The %1$s sign-in page uses risk-control verification (reCAPTCHA), which cannot be completed in the in-app web view, so web sign-in is not offered here. Paste the Cookie directly instead.
Cookie
How to get it: sign in to %1$s in a desktop browser, open Developer Tools (F12) → Application / Storage → Cookies, and copy the entire Cookie for the site.

Web sign-in instructions
1. Sign in to your Xunlei account in the web page below (SMS code / QR / password all work)
2. Sign-in is detected and completed automatically; no manual action is usually needed
3. If it does not sign in automatically, tap \"Save\" in the top-right corner to extract it once
4. If it still fails, tap the \"Paste\" icon and paste the credential JSON from the web session
5. Web sign-in tokens renew automatically; sign in again once they expire
139 Netdisk sign-in
1. Sign in to your 139 Netdisk account in the web page below (phone number)
2. Sign-in is detected automatically. If not, tap \"Save\" in the top-right corner
3. Or tap the \"Paste\" icon to enter the Cookie manually (must include Os_SSo_Sid= and RMKEY=)
4. If the page is blank: sign in at yun.139.com in a system browser, then copy and paste the Cookie; the result is the same
5. The Cookie has a limited lifetime; sign in again once it expires
